title: R-07-031 follow-up: wire C congestion into CoAP server path + Rust server-side 5.03 duty-cycle builder
description: Deferred from b7z9.138 (threshold constants now fixed to 500/800/950 with strict >950 for Exhausted, matching spec 07 10.2.4 + Python params.py + Rust duty_cycle.rs). Remaining: (1) C lichen_congestion_level_from_usage / lichen_duty_congestion_response still have NO production caller — wire congestion state into the C CoAP server request path (related: b7z9.45 C 5.03 emission + sender backoff); (2) Rust lacks a server-side duty-cycle 5.03 CBOR builder mirroring python params.py:239-292 congestion_service_unavailable (only generic service_unavailable in rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1137-1140 for capability-table-full).
